Audit uncovered two actionable issues:

1. **Production builds treat any “sandbox receipt” as a trusted verification override.**

Impact: unauthorized premium access/gating bypass across restore/purchase/verification flows. 2. **Referral-code enforcement collapses whenever the CloudKit check is offline, letting codes be reused repeatedly.**

There is no retry or reconciliation after reconnecting, so the same code can be redeemed on multiple devices simply by forcing offline redemption, which defeats the “single-use” promise and lets anyone brute-force the enumerable prefixes. Impact: attackers can unlock trial/monthly/yearly/lifetime access for free by repeatedly forcing offline redemption. Mitigation: treat network failures as unverified (don’t redeem) or queue the redemption until CloudKit can confirm uniqueness; consider moving codes to server-side and rate-limiting/validating on every redemption attempt.
